mapper.select: SELECT CAFE_MEMBER_ID AS cafeMemberId, CAFE_ID AS cafeId, MEMBER_USERNAME AS memberUsername, CAFE_ROLE AS cafeRole, STATUS, JOINED_AT AS joinedAt FROM CAFE_MEMBER WHERE CAFE_ID = #{cafeId} ORDER BY CASE STATUS WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 WHEN 'BANNED' THEN 3 WHEN 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, CASE CAFE_ROLE WHEN 'OWNER' THEN 1 WHEN 'MANAGER' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEMBER' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, JOINED_AT ASC

SELECT CAFE_MEMBER_ID AS cafeMemberId, CAFE_ID AS cafeId, MEMBER_USERNAME AS memberUsername, CAFE_ROLE AS cafeRole, STATUS, JOINED_AT AS joinedAt FROM CAFE_MEMBER WHERE CAFE_ID = #{cafeId} AND MEMBER_USERNAME = #{memberUsername} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAFE_MEMBER ( CAFE_MEMBER_ID, CAFE_ID, MEMBER_USERNAME, CAFE_ROLE ) VALUES ( SEQ_CAFE_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{cafeId}, #{memberUsername}, #{cafeRole} )
mapper.select: SELECT CAFE_MEMBER_ID AS cafeMemberId, CAFE_ID AS cafeId, MEMBER_USERNAME AS memberUsername, CAFE_ROLE AS cafeRole, STATUS, JOINED_AT AS joinedAt FROM CAFE_MEMBER WHERE CAFE_ID = #{cafeId} AND MEMBER_USERNAME = #{memberUsername}
mapper.update: UPDATE CAFE_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', CAFE_ROLE = 'MEMBER', JOINED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CAFE_ID = #{cafeId} AND MEMBER_USERNAME = #{memberUsername} AND STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN'
